text:
alex: Heads up — middleware import failing on vercel edge for some users. Build OK, runtime throws: 
```
Uncaught TypeError: The requested module '@redwood/inference-js' does not provide an export named 'default'
```

nora: That screams ESM interop. Are folks using `import Redwood from` or named imports? Next middleware runs in the edge runtime (V8) no CJS shim.

jin: We had a subtle one: package.json had conditional exports that pointed default -> dist/index.cjs for legacy, but no pure ESM path for `./middleware` consumers. Next will attempt to load the package root.

alex: Repro attached: https://github.com/org/repro-next-edge-import — middleware.ts uses `import Redwood from '@redwood/inference-js'`. Works in node serverless functions but fails in Edge.

devrel-bot: RW-912 created: "Provide explicit ESM edge entrypoint + docs" — assignee @nora.

omar: Short-term patch: use `import * as RW from '@redwood/inference-js'` then `const client = RW.createClient(...)`. Long-term: add "./edge": {"types":"./dist/edge/index.d.ts","default":"./dist/edge/index.mjs"} to exports. Also ensure dist/edge bundle avoids `fs`, `crypto` node: imports.

jin: Also add a small sample under devex/examples/next-middleware, include tsconfig change: add "lib": ["esnext", "dom"] so Request/Response types resolve.

alex: Will open PR with repro + docs and example. PR link once ready. Thanks!
